crossRefs.note: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and…
But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this…
But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

translations.web: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
translations.bsb: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
translations.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
translations.asv: one who for a certain insurrection made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.
